## Group labels

Use exactly:

- `Experimental`
- `Control`

The experimental group is expected to have a DSP-Lab export and the post-study questionnaire. The control group normally has no DSP-Lab export during the intervention period.

## Code-to-name mapping

If course administration requires a code-to-name key, create it as a separate restricted file outside the research dataset. Do not upload that mapping into the public repository or merge it with app exports, analysis files, fidelity logs, or manuscript files.

A participant code should stay the same for the pre-test, weekly intervention records, post-test, questionnaire, and analysis dataset.
